name: Bromperidol decanoate
aliases: Bromidol Depot, Bromodol Decanoato, Impromen Decanoas
summary: Bromperidol decanoate, sold under the brand names Bromidol Depot, Bromodol Decanoato, and Impromen Decanoas, is an antipsychotic which has been marketed in Europe and Latin America. It is an antipsychotic ester and long-acting prodrug of bromperidol which is administered by depot intramuscular injection once every 4 weeks.

pharmacology.text: It is an antipsychotic ester and long-acting prodrug of bromperidol which is administered by depot intramuscular injection once every 4 weeks.

uses.text: Bromperidol decanoate, sold under the brand names Bromidol Depot, Bromodol Decanoato, and Impromen Decanoas, is an antipsychotic which has been marketed in Europe and Latin America.
uses.brands: Bromidol Depot, Bromodol Decanoato, Impromen Decanoas

sideEffects.en: Because it releases bromperidol, its effects are those of an older antipsychotic: stiffness, tremor, restlessness, sedation and raised prolactin. Long-term use risks tardive dyskinesia, lasting involuntary movements.
sideEffects.zh: 由於它會釋出 bromperidol，其反應就是舊型抗精神病藥的反應：肌肉僵硬、顫抖、坐立不安、鎮靜與泌乳素升高。長期使用有遲發性運動障礙的風險，即持續的不自主動作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 由于它会发布 bromperidol，其反应就是旧型抗精神病药的反应：肌肉僵硬、颤抖、坐立不安、镇静与泌乳素升高。长期使用有迟发性运动障碍的风险，即持续的不自主动作。

fact.en: It is bromperidol tied to decanoic acid, a ten carbon fatty acid. The oily ester leaves the injection site slowly, so one injection lasts for weeks.
fact.zh: 它是把 bromperidol 連接到十個碳的脂肪酸癸酸上的產物。這種油性酯類從注射部位緩慢釋出，因此一次注射可持續數週。
fact.zhHans: 它是把 bromperidol 连接到十个碳的脂肪酸癸酸上的产物。这种油性酯类从注射部位缓慢发布，因此一次注射可持续数周。
